horoscope: On this day after a New Moon in your partnership sector, dear Aries, you can be filling up with hope, optimism, and a strong desire to make improvements. You’re well-positioned to attract helpful people into your life, or you might find special joy in a relationship. Still, it's not yet a straightforward time to compromise, but the friction now can ultimately bring you closer to understanding your deeper needs. Passions run high as the day advances, and you may be dealing with some frustration. Sudden urges and desires may reflect inner unrest more than inner truth.

You can feel on the verge of pleasing improvements in work, health, and habits, dear Taurus, on this day after a New Moon in your solar sixth house. Waves of feeling are feeding your spirit for doing good business, improving your daily routines, and attending to your wellness pursuits. You can feel especially motivated for self-improvement efforts. With your eye for what needs to change, it’s a great time to make your daily life more efficient and fulfilling. As the day advances, watch for jumping to conclusions or jumping to communicate before thinking. You can be on edge, particularly if you have so much to do that you don’t know where to begin.

On this day after a New Moon, you can feel particularly hopeful and open to making changes, dear Gemini. It can be a time for discovering old resources or ideas that benefit you in the present. As the day progresses, you're likely to feel more serious or determined, but you may also be a little too quick to speak about something that needs time to develop or be understood. If an urge for something comes on very suddenly, wait to see if it passes before indulging. The most benefits come from observation rather than action, but do listen to your desire for change.

On this day after a New Moon, dear Cancer, improving your domestic life boosts your confidence. You may be devising ways to put frustrating situations behind you so you can start fresh. Your nesting urge is also strong. It’s a great time to get in touch with any needs and desires you’ve kept at bay or suppressed. Still, you’re gearing up for a more outgoing period as the Moon moves into your solar fifth house today. As the day advances, however, it may be a good strategy to avoid jumping into or out of something too quickly until you get a stronger handle on what you genuinely want and need. Watch for a situation of "too much too soon" today.

Improving your communications and connections is in focus, dear Leo, on this day after a New Moon in your solar third house. You can gain a pleasant, helpful perspective through a friend or network. Others are attracted to your ideas and your intelligence, more than usual. You may be dancing around your feelings instead of facing them, however. There can also be benefits from doing behind-the-scenes work and rewards for past efforts. Complicated feelings and desires can easily bubble up to the surface, especially as the day advances. Tap into your inner courage and find your passion, then think about ways to express it all. With the Moon's move into your solar fourth house, you’re in great shape to spend more time with your thoughts and inner world.

You’re looking at your finances, talents, belongings, and business in new ways today, dear Virgo, on this day after a New Moon. You want to make improvements, and your confidence is building. You have a fresh and positive attitude towards your self-worth and value. You value simple pleasures and activities that comfort you. It’s a generally good time to get your resources in order and learn your needs. The Moon heads into your communications sector, and you may crave some connection and communication as the day advances. Others’ ideas jumpstart your thinking. But even with extra motivation and mental liveliness today, you enjoy an easy and comfortable pace. While it’s not the perfect day for decision-making, you’re getting a better understanding of what you need and want.

It’s a time of creative self-expression and finding yourself on this day after a New Moon in your sign, dear Libra. Enthusiasm for recent new ventures is building, and you may have exciting revisions you’re eager to make. You are likely in demand in a mostly positive way. This isn’t a time to dwell on the past, as you are focused with determination on what you can accomplish now and in the future. Aim to use any tension emerging now as motivation to improve. Off timing in relationships could ultimately lead to new ideas. If you can center yourself and draw on your inner wisdom, your charisma will shine through more naturally, which can positively impact your business relationships or connections with someone in authority.

On this day after a New Moon, you can feel good about having more channels or outlets for expressing yourself or opening up, dear Scorpio. You can experience breakthroughs on a psychological or intimate level now, giving you a solid sense you’re moving forward. It’s a fine time to support others and feel great about doing so. A lot is going on behind the scenes, and you may be glowing with excitement. Even with this enthusiasm, you begin the day in a mode where you're taking stock, staying in the background, and laying low. The Moon later enters your sign, and you begin to crave more feedback and interaction. As the day advances, a square working behind the scenes in your chart may obscure the true source of your discontent. Try tackling things one at a time rather than wearing yourself out.

This can be a time when changes or innovations are stirring in a friendship, dear Sagittarius. A special plan may be forming, and it has you working towards realizing some of your most treasured wishes. On this day after a New Moon, it’s a powerful time to let go of preconceived ideas of what friendships and relationships “should” be. The Moon does head into your privacy sector today, and getting some rest or a break from the action can be especially appropriate. As the day advances, you may also feel a bit impatient with others, largely due to stronger-than-usual feelings, but your personal magnetism runs very high today.

You may be thinking about upgrades and improved methods today, dear Capricorn, and it can be motivating on this day after a New Moon. Ideally, clearing the air has helped you turn a page, but you might also choose to ride things out and observe rather than take action. It's probably not in your best interests to push forward too hard as you reorient yourself and shuffle your goals just a little. As the day advances, someone may be vying for your attention, perhaps disruptively. Channel excess energy into something productive, such as into a subject or topic you’re interested in. An empowering conversation or exchange of ideas may be part of the picture now.

On this day after a New Moon in your solar ninth house, you can feel as if you’re freeing yourself of restrictions, dear Aquarius, particularly in your self-expression. Breaking the regular routine can be most refreshing now. Emotions may rule over reason just for now, and your need to expand your horizons on a personal level is powerful. Still, your motivation for work or daily routines can be especially dynamic, and you can use it positively by pouring your energy into your projects or health endeavors. Providing a service or volunteering your help to someone can be enormously rewarding.

On this day after a New Moon, you can feel a sense that things are improving, dear Pisces, and that you can make things happen. You could feel relieved of a burden, helping you move on. It’s a good time for financial support, and an intimate relationship can be exciting while also helping you feel supported. Letting go of past conditioning or unhealthy ties to the past are themes as you begin a new cycle. New developments on an emotional level leave you feeling hopeful. Later today, tensions can be stirring and even productive, but avoid getting yourself into a stressed situation or state. Restlessness could turn your focus to instant gratification, but it’s better to look for the root of dissatisfaction and work from there.
